Author: mole99
Content:
Some operations perform merging under the hood, while for others you either don't want due to performance reasons, or need to merge explicitly.
https://www.klayout.de/drc_function_internals.html

Author: 246tnt
Content:
ATM there is 
`merge = (ctx.options.run_mode != 'deep')`

So if `run_mode` is anything but `deep` it performs a merge on the layer it extracts.
